subject: general
question:
Simplify the given expression. 

((2)/(3)+(1)/(3))times 23-13+9
solution:
**Given:**

(2/3 + 1/3) × 23 − 13 + 9

**Formula used:**

**BODMAS** Rule (Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

(2/3 + 1/3) × 23 − 13 + 9

⇒ (3/3) × 23 − 13 + 9

⇒ 1 × 23 − 13 + 9

⇒ 23 − 13 + 9

⇒ 10 + 9

⇒ 19

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
